title: Leather Chelsea Boot
description:
Background: With the exception of the "Python" colorway, all these were made with a thick suede. Their packaging will acknowledge that, with the suede pairs being referred to as "Thick Suede Chelsea Boot" on the box. Meanwhile, "Python" Chelsea boots are called "Roccia Mesa Embossed Leather Chelsea Boot". The Python colorway was also significantly more expensive, retailing for $930 while the other colorways were priced at $580.

All pairs were made in Romania and pair their leather colorway with a tonal sole.
